notes.title: Version 1.20 update
notes.notes:
The game now supports controller. The left wheel represents the mouse moving, A represents the left mouse click, and B represents cancel or return.（ But the recommended manipulation method is still the mouse)

Gameplay improvement:

1. The effect of unit ability Indomitable is adjusted to:
Unit suffers no extra damage when its morale low, and will not retreat even when its morale reduced to 0.
2. The calculation of auto battle is adjusted. The problem that the Shield and Fields  play too much role has been resolved.
3. The Emishi Pirates' Policy Advanced Radar was replaced to B-Field Energy.

Fix bugs:

1. Fixed a bug causing game crash when a tempeted enemy unit destroying enemy flagship and retreat because morale decreased.
2. Fixed a bug that Omnic's Policy Precise Wave did not take effect.
3. Fixed a bug that Chen Wentai's tactical skill were not displayed in the interface when took effect.

It may be the last update of Chaos Galaxy. At the end of September, Chaos Galaxy 2 will release a demo version. About half a year after that, Chaos Galaxy 2 will release the Early Access. Let's party in Chaos Galaxy 2 next year!

notes.title: Chaos Galaxy Complete Version
notes.notes:
Hello, friends.

Chaos Galaxy has been updated for more than three months since it was released on June 16. We have made 82 game optimizations and modified 73 bugs. Added 20 special flagships, Space Lanes system, and Badge, Trading Cards, Profile Backgrounds, Emoticons. So far, thIS game has basically achieved my goal of the Complete Version.

However, Chaos Galaxy still has many shortcomings, for example, the workshop and alien factions, which have been suggested many times by players, have not added to the game. Due to my lack of experience, the code of Chaos galaxy is not suitable for Mod function; as for the alien, I feel my previous attempts in Chaos Sector are not entirely satisfactory. I want to create more interesting alien monsters and behaviors, as well as a series of new units derived from a new technology trees players can get from fighting against aliens, etc., but these contents will certainly destroy the existing game structure of Chaos Galaxy. In addition, I think the planetary management system in Chaos Galaxy is too simple, and I hope to completely redo a planetary building system.

All these regrets will be made up in my next game. Yes, Chaos Galaxy will have a sequel. The next game is not just a systematic upgrade of Chaos Galaxy, but a real sequel to the story's timeline. Many factions in Chaos Galaxy will perish, some will split, some will be wandering, and new factions will appear on the stage of the Galaxy. You can think of the relationship between Chaos Galaxy and the next sequel as the relationship between Star Wars 1 and Star Wars 2 or Warhammer 40000 7th and 8th Edition. The story will move forward and the game system will be changed in some ways while inheriting the merit of the old. I want to spend ten years to make Chaos Galaxy into a series of games with an in-depth story background.

I expect to release some details of the sequel early next year. I hope you can keep an eye on the Chaos Galaxy universe!

If you find some bugs of Chaos Galaxy or have some suggestions for the sequel, please post it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. I will continue to modify the newly discovered bugs in Chaos Galaxy, and I will use your suggestions as a reference for the design of the sequel. Thanks very much for your help and support!

notes.title: Version 1.13 update
notes.notes:
Gameplay improvement:

1. Beginner mode is available. Choosing beginner mode at the start of a campaign will increase the player base-income of gold and supply.
2. After being bombarded by a map weapon, the units in stealth will appear.

Fix bugs:

1. Fixed some bugs about the commander's tactical bar on the battlefield.
2. Fixed some bugs that enemy units' level-icon and energy bar animation sometimes can be seen through the battlefield fog.

If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.12 update
notes.notes:
Gameplay improvement:

1. We slightly increase the diplomatic requirements of Ask for war and slightly reduce the diplomatic requirements of Hire for war.
2. Planets with features of Wasteland will no longer be a mission target of the yearly strategic meeting.
3. When AI selects a war target, it will only select from factions with planet lanes connected to its own planets.
4. Only some specific factions' commanders will get the skills Invisible and Inkognito when they are promoted.
5. Seiged planets will be cut off from their lanes to the other planets.
6. AI stealth units on the battlefield will try to stay away from enemy units.
7. A sleeping fleet's button will display the word Sleeping, and the button will have no animation.
8. Some text has been adjusted.

Fix bugs:

1. Fixed a bug that when AI ambushing players, if we don't watch the animation, the damage calculation result will be based on a normal attack.
2. Fixed a bug that the relationship with allies doesn't increase when we assisting allies in auto battle.


If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.11 update and Space Lane system available
notes.notes:
New content:

1. A new Space lane system is available. The planets are connected by lanes now. Our fleet can move by twice range on the lanes between our planets and the friendly planets.
2. New commander's random skills added: Tactical Genius, Telepathy, Invisible, Inkognito. The commanders with higher Military are more likely to have random skills of military-type on Promotion, and commanders with higher Administer are more likely to have random skills of admin-type on Promotion.
3. The Transfer ability of troops has been remade. Now a transfer unit can reach the destination directly without encountering ambush on the road and can cross the asteroid belt area. If the transfer unit is ambushed by a submarine at the destination, it will jump back to the starting point after the fight.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/cff3dec57928a6bd24007f6c603b2b97d2ebc29f.png[/img]

Gameplay improvement:

1. The Mozi order's policy Precise Fortgun was replaced by Fort Armour, Fortgun Range was replaced by Fort En-recycle. the effects of those policies were also adjusted. The faction difficulty of the Mozi order was changed to normal.
2. The fleet composition of AI has been adjusted. Now most AI fleets will not have two support units.
3. When the game window loses focus, the game sound will no longer be played.
4. Fixed some damage calculation ways for auto battles.
5. Increased more Agility when unit level up. High-level mecha units become easier to dodge enemy fire now.
6. Red Samurai's movement increased by 1.
7. When attacked by the second attack of Double Shooting or Double Chopping, the attacked unit can only do dodge now.

Fix bugs:

1. Fixed a bug that units did not gain experience in auto-battle.
2. Fixed a bug about occasionally miss on the 100% hit rate.
3. Fixed bugs about game stuck in several diplomacy and events.
4. Fixed some bugs when selecting fleets in the strategy scene.
5. Fixed a bug about the tactics skill Dimension Disorder.
6. Fixed a bug in the combat animation of the Red Samurai.

If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.10 update
notes.notes:
Gameplay improvement:

1. In the unit data UI on the battlefield, now we can see the faction emblem of the unit, and we can hover the mouse over the emblem to see the name of the fleet which the unit belongs to.
2. When we offering planets to our suzerain, we can now choose many planets at once.
3. On the diplomatic UI, now we can see how many planets the selected faction has.
4. The skill effect of units on the battlefield has been adjusted. Now some effects expire at the end of a turn, and the other effects expire at the beginning of a turn. You can check their skill descriptions for details.
5. The models of the flagships of the Omnic Apocalypse have been adjusted.
6、The moving speed of units on the battlefield is faster now.
7.  In the faction selection UI, the difficulty of the Lycurgus Corps is adjusted from hard to normal, and the difficulty of the Aerie Assassins is adjusted from hell to hard,
8. The Omnic Apocalypse's policy Wide Command was changed to a new policy Component, and the effect was also modified.
9. Improved AI's priority in using the Devour ability of space worms.

Fix bugs:

1. Fixed a bug about a hit rate of 0% that could still hit.
2. Fixed a bug about the Overhaul ability failed to repair friendly units.
3. Fixed a bug that title skill Invincible didn't work correctly.
4. Fixed a bug that the damage details on the fight UI sometimes is incomplete.
5. Fixed a bug that the map weapons did not gain damage modify correction.
6. Fixed a bug that the Westwaste Fleet's policy Starkiller Range failed to increase the range of Starkiller.
7. Fixed a bug in the battle animation of Fogblade.
8. Fixed a bug in the combat animation of the Suicide Nuke Servitor.
9. Fixed a bug that space hackers may use virus ability on targets already infected.
10. Fixed a bug that some tactical skills might allow the fortress to gain movement ability.

If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

Advance notice for next update:
A big update will be available at the end of this month about the Space Lanes system, and some modify about the random skills of commanders. Coming soon!

notes.title: Version 1.09 update and new flagships available
notes.notes:
[b]New content:[/b]

1. Twenty powerful new flagship units join the game, each belongs to the leader of each faction and several important commanders. We can get their collections by defeating them on the battlefield.
2. New planetary features added to the game: Science center, Logistics center, Media capital, Fortress planet. and most other planetary features have been modified. This content needs a new game to take effect.
3. The number of save slots has increased from 6 to 18.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/3b101007a27faccf2d601c4fc189ececd6d9fe2a.png[/img]

[b]Gameplay improvement:[/b]

1. The gold cost for early policies of all factions has been reduced.
2. The lead, power, and price of the Spaceworm were reduced, and the policy tree order about the Spaceworm was adjusted.
3. The damage of Map weapons no longer change randomly.
4. The conditions for the event Punish Southsea, Punish Eastgalaxy, 2nd AI War, Death of Princess, and Princess Crowned have been adjusted. When the related factions are vassals of other factions, no event will occur.
5. After a successful temptation, we can now control the target unit for 3 turns instead of 1 turn.
6. At the start of a turn, all units will detect the submarines around them as at the end of a turn.
7. The camera will be moved to the selected fleet when you choose a reinforcement fleet before a battle.
8. Duplicate buff names will no longer appear in the fight animations.
9. When an AI unit has Double Shooting effect, AI will give priority to using ammunition weapons to attack the enemy.
10. AI will no longer supply a unit with Supply ability.
11. Modified the sound effect of God Fist.

[b]Fix bugs:[/b]

1. Fixed a bug about Southeaven Fleet's policy Valiant.
2. Fixed a bug about the tactical skill Sand Assault.
3. Fixed a bug about the diplomatic command Offer planet.

If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.08 update
notes.notes:
Gameplay improvement:

1. Now we can suggest our suzerain to attack a faction.
2. Now we can ask planets from our vassals easier. But it will be harder to annex our vassals.
3. In the faction selection UI, the difficulty of Omnic Apocalypse is adjusted from hard to hell.
4. In the event 2nd AI War, Omnic Apocalypse will gain 20000 gold.
5. In the event Rebel Command, the flagship of all newly added AI commanders will be changed to Omnic Flagship.
6. Spaceworms get the ability of Self Heal.

Fix bugs:

1. If a reinforcement fleet does not arrive at the battlefield and the battle has failed, the reinforcement fleet will not be destroyed.
2. Fixed a bug in the strategy meeting.

If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

Advance notice for next update:
A big update will be available in mid-August about the special flagships, new planet features, and a galaxy chronicle. Coming soon!

notes.title: Version 1.07 update
notes.notes:
Gameplay improvement:

1. Now we can ask allies to attack our enemies. AI allies will also come to us and ask for reinforcements.
2. Now we can hire mercenary factions to attack our enemies.
3. Now we can offer our planet to our suzerain.
4. The animation of the EndTurn button for the strategy map and battlefield will now be more eye-catching.
5. Vsync is set to limit the fps.

Fix bugs:

1. Fixed a bug that sometimes the title skill Southeaven Flower does not work.
2. Fix a bug that may appear in strategic missions.
3. Fixed a bug that the commanders sometimes failed to save learned skills.
4. Fixed a bug that the title skill Chief of Kurushima gives supply instead of gold.

If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.06 update
notes.notes:
Gameplay improvement:

1.When a faction gets blueprints from destroying an enemy faction, annexing a vassal, or in the random event of Omnic Apocalypse, they will not get a blueprint which already in their policy tree.
2. On the battlefield, AI using range weapons will be given priority to attacking enemy targets that have been locked.
3. Omnic Apocalypse will no longer be able to annex the human factions through diplomacy.
4. Increased the priority of AI's Space Hacker using Virus.

Fix bugs:

1. Fixed a possible display error when the player selecting reinforcements to join a battle.
2. Fixed some text display errors of UI.
3. Fixed some mistakes in diplomatic dialogue.
4. Fixed a bug that might occur when our unit counterattacked the enemy on the battlefield.

If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.05 update
notes.notes:
Gameplay improvement:

1. The diplomatic relations of the selected faction will be shown on the Diplomatic UI.
2. We can choose not to set a strategic goal in the annual meeting now.
3. On the battlefield, AI will give priority to protecting its own flagship.
4. Fleet added Sleep / Awake command.
5. Slightly increased the success rate of the tempting action.
6. Now, using a map weapon will cause weapon failure at random just like any other weapon. Units attacked by map weapons will also have faults at random as they are attacked by other weapons.

Fix bugs:

1. Fixed a possible animation error when units make a second attack.
2. Fixed a bug about units that have Transfer skill may disappear if they are ambushed by submarines.

If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.04 update
notes.notes:
Gameplay improvement:

1. Reinforcements that have not arrived on the battlefield will not accumulate tactical points.
2. A fleet lost its flagship cannot use tactical skills.
3. In the battlefield, the unit's vision is set to be equaled with its move point. (except fortress)
4. Increases the success rate in Assassination and Temptation.
5. After entering the battlefield, the units will automatically select the appropriate initial direction.
6. The Appear action of submarines needs to be confirmed.

Fix bugs:

1. Fixed a bug that the player using the tactical skill Strongest Virus may infest player units.
2. Fixed a bug that a fired commander not removed from his position of planetary governor.
3. Fixed a bug that the Regent forces sometimes do not recruit troops.
4. Fixed bugs that some AI fleets sometimes acted strangely.
5. Fixed a bug that did not include Disaster Ship in the number of submarines in strategic missions.
6. Fixed some UI Bugs.
7. Fixed a bug that the Title Skill Desert Prophet works incorrectly.
8. Fixed a bug that the Omnic Apocalypse sometimes hire human commanders.

If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

Advance notice for next update:
Badge, Trading Cards, Profile Backgrounds, and Emoticons will be available in mid-July.

notes.title: Version 1.03 update
notes.notes:
Gameplay improvement:

1. After a diplomatic annexation, the faction asking the annexation can try to recruit commanders of the annexed faction.
2. The supply required to recruit the support type units were reduced.
3. The Imperial Court will be more inclined to choose the player faction to execute the events of Abolish Edict, Compliance Edict and Takeover Planet.
4. Reduced the volume of the logo sound.

Fix bugs:

1. Fixed some wrong text.
2. Fixed a problem with the wrong icon color of Privateer Battleship obtained by the Omnic Apocalypse.
3. Fixed a display error in the battle animation of the Prince Class Dreadnaught.
4. Fixed an error in the event story when the Galactic Empire was destroyed by force.
5. Fixed a bug in which automatic battle was unable to complete the novice task: Defeat Enemy.
6. Fixed bug that the map weapons may be fired twice by clicking the direction button in succession.
7. Fixed several bugs when players assisted friendly Planetary Fortress.
8. Fixed a bug that AI fortress will fight back when it is attacked from behind by AI units.
9. Fixed a bug that might have occurred when a player unit was ambushed by an enemy submarine.

If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.02 update
notes.notes:
Gameplay improvement:

1. AI commanders no longer automatically gain credit. (The dev give in to you guys. >_<)
2. The Regent Forces and the Royalist Alliance will not accept each other's truce requests.
3. The suzerains are more inclined to oppress their vasals. 
4 Slightly increased AI's priority of using map weapons on the battlefield.

Fix bugs:

1. Fixed a bug that might appear on the fleet list page arrow buttons.
2. Fixed a bug that the prestige display does not refresh after an auto-battle.
3. Fixed a bug on the policies of Pella Corps.
4. Fixed a bug that may appear when players assist in AI Ally's battle.
5. Fixed a bug that AI might use map weapons to counterattack an AI troop.
6. Fixed a display error in the recruit menu.
7. Fixed some bugs of the tactical skill Unyielding Soul.
8. Fixed an error of the tactical skill Omnic Assault.
9. Fixed some text errors.
10. Fixed a bug that the Power Shield can defend against ram weapons.
11. Fixed a bug that AI units sometimes recover energy at the end of a battle,
12. Fixed a bug about the color for combat animation of some factions' melee units.
13. Fixed a bug that might appear in auto-battle to attack a planet.

If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.01 update
notes.notes:
[b]Gameplay improvement:[/b]

1. In the battle, The reinforcements of player faction will be controlled by yourself, while those of non-player faction fleets are still controlled by AI.
2. The duration of the tactical skill Unyielding Soul has been changed from 3 turns to 2 turns.
3. Adjusted the position of the unit actions panel.
4. Reduces the AI commander's auto gain credit.

[b]Fix bugs:[/b]

1. Level-max unit will not consumes supplies in training.
2. Fixed the problem of AI using  tactical skill Unyielding Soul incorrectly.
3. Fixed the problem that the player used the tactical skill Blade of Jihad incorrectly.
4. Fixed incorrect display of recruitment UI
5. Fixed a few help text errors
6. Fixed position error in the policy tree of Southeaven Fleet.
7. Fixed the battle animation of the Musketeer.
8. Fixed a dialogue error in diplomatic annexation.
9. Fixed a possible bug in recruiting a commander.

There are many updates and changes. If you find any bug, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!
